PSALM CXL. 
 
  David prays and hopes for deliverance from his enemies, ver. 1-7.   Foretells their destruction, ver. 8-13.   To the chief musician, A psalm of David.
V. 3. Tongues-Using words as sharp and piercing as the sting of a serpent.
V. 9. Mischief-The mischief which they design against me, shall fall upon themselves.
V. 10. Coals-Divine vengeance, which is compared to coals of fire.
V. 13. Dwell-Shall constantly enjoy thy gracious and powerful presence.
